title: Savas's "Rebel Still" Empowers Listeners to Embrace their Inner Rebels
htmlContent:
Savas, the New South Wales-based hip-hop artist, is ready to kick off 2023 with a bang through his latest single, "Rebel Still." The Man's iconic track, the song, celebrates confidence and rebellion. 

Drawing inspiration from Portugal with heavy baselines and 808 kick drums, "Rebel Still" creates a vibrant soundscape for Savas's effortless flow. The song empowers listeners to embrace inner rebels and unleash their true potential.

Produced by Sergio Brown Perez, aka Nonsome, and mastered by Louise Issac, aka Kid Fiction, "Rebel Still" promises to add to Savas's impressive catalog. The artist's unique sound and relatable lyrics have already earned him a dedicated fan base and recognition within the industry.

Scheduled for a worldwide release on March 9th, 2023, "Rebel Still" will also be accompanied by a visual post-release. As a rising star in Australia's hip-hop scene, Savas's latest single is a testament to his talent and artistry and a reminder to his fans to stay true to themselves and embrace their rebellious spirit.
